# Rules the system must obey

The rules on the owner's solidity ladder: **1 natural law**, **2 law**, **3 industry rule**, **4 business rule**. Levels 5-8 are design and below and are not stored here. Every rule is in force. **ratified** means in force and not interim; **provisional** means in force and expected to lose ground when its falsifier fires. (The standard's own `ratified` status covers both.) A rule's **falsifier** is what would make it stop applying.

## System-wide rules

### Money values are strings in JSON — ratified
Rule: All money values are strings.
Level: 3 industry rule
Authority: IETF RFC 8259 §6
Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8259.txt
Applies at: src/money.ts DecimalConverter; acme/react: anchor a_1
Falsifier: Acme drops JSON.
Accepted deviations: the legacy converter still reads JSON numbers (revalidate by 2027-01-01)
Id: r_json
